input.command:
mkdir -p "C:/Users/<user>/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--Users-<user>-AppData-Local-Temp-prompt-evals-session-246k2760/746ffc71-7312-45f9-9ca6-32ec465ba1b2/scratchpad" && cd "$_" && cat > analyze.py <<'EOF'
import re, collections
src = r"C:/Users/<user>/AppData/Local/Temp/prompt-evals-session-246k2760/personal_expenses.txt"
CATS = {
 "Dining & Coffee": ["Local Coffee Co","Chipotle","McDonald's","Rustic Tap Brewery","Panera Bread","Starbucks","Sushi Kame","Thai Orchid","Bagel Corner","Luigi's Pizza"],
 "Shopping": ["Amazon (", "Amazon,", "Amazon -","Best Buy","Target","Old Navy","REI","Barnes & Noble","IKEA","Home Depot"],
 "Groceries": ["Trader Joe's","Aldi","Kroger","Whole Foods","Costco"],
 "Gas & Auto": ["Shell","Chevron","BP Gas","Jiffy Lube"],
 "Rideshare & Parking": ["Lyft","Uber","City Parking Authority"],
 "Subscriptions & Bills": ["iCloud+","Amazon Prime","Xfinity","Netflix","Spotify Premium","Verizon","Planet Fitness App"],
 "Health & Fitness": ["Riverside Physical Therapy","Dental","Walgreens","CVS","Planet Fitness"],
 "Entertainment": ["Spotify Concert","AMC","Bowl-O-Rama","Ticketmaster","Steam"],
 "Travel": ["Delta","Airport Parking","Marriott","Hertz"],
 "Transfers & Cash": ["Zelle","Venmo","ATM","PayPal"],
}
MON = {"Jun":"Jun","Jul":"Jul","Aug":"Aug","6":"Jun","7":"Jul","8":"Aug","06":"Jun","07":"Jul","08":"Aug"}
rows=[]
for ln in open(src,encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines()[3:]:
    if not ln.strip(): continue
    amts = re.findall(r'(-?)\$?(-?)(\d+\.\d{2})', ln)
    s,s2,a = amts[-1]; amt = float(a)*(-1 if (s or s2) and "Return" in ln else 1)
    m = re.search(r'\b(Jun|Jul|Aug)', ln) or re.search(r'2026-(0\d)-', ln) or re.search(r'\b(0?[678])[/-]\d', ln)
    mon = MON[m.group(1)]
    cat = next((c for c,ks in CATS.items() for k in ks if k in ln), None)
    if cat is None and "Amazon" in ln: cat="Shopping"
    rows.append((mon,cat,amt,ln))
for r in rows:
    if r[1] is None: print("UNCAT",r)
tot=collections.defaultdict(float); cnt=collections.Counter()
for mon,cat,amt,ln in rows: tot[(cat,mon)]+=amt; cnt[(cat,mon)]+=1
ms=["Jun","Jul","Aug"]
print(len(rows))
for c in CATS:
    v=[tot[(c,m)] for m in ms]; print(f"{c:24}", " ".join(f"{x:9.2f}({cnt[(c,m)]:2})" for x,m in zip(v,ms)), f"{sum(v):9.2f}")
print("TOTAL", [round(sum(tot[(c,m)] for c in CATS),2) for m in ms], round(sum(tot.values()),2))
for c in ["Dining & Coffee","Shopping","Travel","Groceries"]:
    print("==",c)
    for r in rows:
        if r[1]==c: print(r[0], r[2], r[3])
EOF
python analyze.py
input.description: Parse and categorize expenses by month

    amts = re.findall(r'(-?)\$?(-?)(\d+\.\d{2})', ln)
    s,s2,a = amts[-1]; amt = float(a)*(-1 if (s or s2) and "Return" in ln else 1)
    m = re.search(r'\b(Jun|Jul|Aug)', ln) or re.search(r'2026-(0\d)-', ln) or re.search(r'\b(0?[678])[/-]\d', ln)
    mon = MON[m.group(1)]
    cat = next((c for c,ks in CATS.items() for k in ks if k in ln), None)
    if cat is None and "Amazon" in ln: cat="Shopping"
    rows.append((mon,cat,amt,ln))
for r in rows:
    if r[1] is None: print("UNCAT",r)
tot=collections.defaultdict(float); cnt=collections.Counter()
for mon,cat,amt,ln in rows: tot[(cat,mon)]+=amt; cnt[(cat,mon)]+=1
ms=["Jun","Jul","Aug"]
print(len(rows))
for c in CATS:

print("TOTAL", [round(sum(tot[(c,m)] for c in CATS),2) for m in ms], round(sum(tot.values()),2))
for c in ["Dining & Coffee","Shopping","Travel","Groceries"]:

I sorted all 198 entries into 10 categories and added them up by month with a script, so the totals below are exact. Two things to keep in mind:

- **Some calls were mine to make.** Costco counts as Groceries, not Shopping. Amazon Prime counts as a Subscription, not Shopping. Steam counts as Entertainment. The REI return (−$68) is subtracted from July Shopping. If you'd count Costco as shopping, that category goes up by $200–400 a month.
- **Your log is incomplete.** By your own note, you didn't record everything, so treat these totals as the least you spent.

## Spending by month and category

| Category | June | July | August | Q3 total | Change Jul→Aug |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Shopping (Amazon, Target, Best Buy, Old Navy, REI, IKEA, B&N, Home Depot) | $1,020.77 | $756.72 | $1,218.31 | **$2,995.80** | +61% |
| Groceries (TJ's, Kroger, Costco, Whole Foods, Aldi) | $624.34 | $883.32 | $982.79 | **$2,490.45** | +11% |
| Travel (Delta, Marriott, Hertz, airport parking) | – | – | $1,631.82 | **$1,631.82** | new |
| Health & Fitness (PT, dental, gym, pharmacy) | $344.25 | $271.17 | $222.80 | **$838.22** | −18% |
| Gas & Auto | $133.63 | $274.59 | $426.99 | **$835.21** | +56% |
| Dining & Coffee | $212.74 | $165.14 | $398.69 | **$776.57** | +141% |
| Transfers & Cash (Zelle, Venmo, ATM, PayPal) | $271.20 | $105.79 | $269.74 | **$646.73** | +155% |
| Subscriptions & Bills (phone, internet, streaming) | $198.58 | $198.58 | $198.58 | **$595.74** | flat |
| Rideshare & Parking | $327.78 | $99.08 | $135.59 | **$562.45** | +37% |
| Entertainment (concerts, movies, Steam) | $143.42 | $135.51 | $160.88 | **$439.81** | +19% |
| **Total** | **$3,276.71** | **$2,889.90** | **$5,646.19** | **$11,812.80** | **+95%** |
| *Total without the trip* | *$3,276.71* | *$2,889.90* | *$4,014.37* | | *+39%* |

## Spending against your budgets

**Dining & coffee (budget: $260/month)**

| | June | July | August | Q3 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Spent | $212.74 | $165.14 | $398.69 | $776.57 |
| Over / (under) budget | ($47.26) | ($94.86) | **+$138.69 (53% over)** | ($3.43) of $780 |
| Number of visits | 10 | 9 | 18 | 37 |
| Average per visit | $21.27 | $18.35 | $22.15 | |

**Shopping (budget: $1,200/month)**

| | June | July | August | Q3 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Spent | $1,020.77 | $756.72* | $1,218.31 | $2,995.80 |
| Over / (under) budget | ($179.23) | ($443.28) | **+$18.31** | ($604.20) of $3,600 |
| Number of purchases | 11 | 8 | 11 | 30 |

*July is $824.72 before the REI return.

## The three most important things

1. **Dining out spiked in August because you went out more often, not because meals cost more.** You had 18 dining and coffee visits in August, about twice as many as in June or July. The average visit stayed around $20, so frequency is what pushed you over. June and July were under budget, so this wasn't a slow creep; it was a sudden jump in August. Because those two months left room, the quarter as a whole comes in just $3 under budget, but only by luck. Lunch places (Panera, Chipotle, Luigi's Pizza) and Rustic Tap Brewery made up most of the increase.

2. **Shopping went over $1,200 for the first time in August, mostly from electronics and books.** It's still well short of the $2,000 you're worried about, and you averaged $999 a month for the quarter. But August was up 61% from July. Best Buy alone came to $593 across four purchases ($340 of it in August), and Barnes & Noble was $156 in August. Shopping is your biggest category, so it's worth watching whether August was a one-off.

3. **August spending nearly doubled. The trip explains most of it, but not all.** The trip (flights, hotel, rental car) cost $1,632. Without it, August was still $4,014, up 39% from July. Gas has tripled since June ($134 → $427), and groceries rose about 57% ($624 → $983). Those increases have nothing to do with the budgets you set, so they're easy to miss.

## Entries worth checking

- **Possible duplicate:** Trader Joe's on July 22 for $54.12 appears twice. If it's a double entry, July groceries drop to $829.20.
- **Two Delta charges on August 14** ($412.60 and $450.60). These could be two tickets, or one booking entered twice.
- **Planet Fitness charges** of $54–74 every month, on top of the $9.99 app. July had two of them ($73.58 and $59.23). Worth confirming that's what you expect to pay.
- **$647 in Zelle, Venmo, ATM and PayPal** has no category. If some of it went to meals or purchases, your real dining or shopping totals are higher than shown here.
